Participants in telephone and Web-based smoking cessation programs in four states were invited to complete questionnaires at enrollment and 7 months afterwards
Participants were asked at follow-up 7 months after enrollment whether they had smoked in the past 30 days

methods_quotes.q: Chi-square tests were used to evaluate differences in proportions, and t-tests were used to evaluate differences in means
